metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills for version control, planning, and development workflows.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Create conventional commit messages (feat, fix, docs, etc.) following the Conventional Commits spec

plugins.name: jj
plugins.description: All version control operations using the Jujutsu (jj) CLI — commits, bookmarks, rebasing, workspaces

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Create a pull request for the current branch with a structured description, using a repo template if one exists

plugins.name: new-feature
plugins.description: Scaffold a new feature: gather requirements, create an isolated workspace, and produce a development plan before writing code

plugins.name: tbd
plugins.description: Plan and implement features as a stack of short-lived, independently-green PRs using trunk-based development

plugins.name: vcs-workflow
plugins.description: Unified VCS workflow: jj for local operations, gh for GitHub, trunk-based development with stacked PRs, and error recovery
